id: 07_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers (Confined Space)
title: 安全员面试问答：受限空间

author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/07_Safety Officer Interview Questions and Answers (Confined Space)/src.py

points.K3: 进入前先办作业许可、人员受训
points.K4: 作业前授权人员气体检测
points.K5: 指派监护人并使用进出登记表
points.K6: 通风、低压照明、进出通道
points.K7: 应急救援预案与救援装备
points.K15: 估算呼吸器的供气时间

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽，站在一个大储罐的人孔旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a hard hat stands beside the manhole of a large storage tank and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的面试题：受限空间！
overlay: 安全员面试问答：受限空间

shots.scene: 一张空白题单，十一行依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank question sheet with eleven rows lighting up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十一道题，逐条来讲。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白题单，看着远处的储罐
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank question sheet and looks at storage tanks in a plant.
shots.narration: 阿杰要面试受限空间方向的安全员。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着人孔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the small manhole on the tank.
shots.narration: 先从定义开始。

shots.scene: 储罐只有一个小人孔，内部半封闭
shots.prompt_en: A partially enclosed tank with only one small manhole for entry and exit. No people.
shots.narration: 受限空间：进出口受限，部分封闭。

shots.scene: 人孔旁一个床铺图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: A bed icon next to the manhole crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为人员长期停留设计的。

shots.scene: 罐内氧气表图标和可燃气团图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the tank, an oxygen gauge icon swinging low and high, and a flammable vapor cloud icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可能缺氧或富氧，可能积聚可燃气体。

shots.scene: 罐内骷髅气团和火焰气团图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the tank, a gas cloud with a skull pictogram and a gas cloud with a flame pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：有毒和可燃气体，火灾爆炸。

shots.scene: 停转的风扇和昏暗的灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A stopped fan icon and a dim light bulb icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通风不良，照明不足。

shots.scene: 氧气表两端分别亮红灯
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen gauge with red zones lit at both the low end and the high end. No people.
shots.narration: 氧低于19.5%缺氧，高于23.5%富氧。

shots.scene: 狭窄人孔和温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A narrow blocked manhole icon and a thermometer icon at an extreme reading. No people.
shots.narration: 进出通道不畅，极端温度。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比划越来越多
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its arms wider and wider as hazard icons multiply around it.
shots.narration: 作业越多，危害越多。

shots.section_title: 进入前先办作业许可、人员受训
shots.scene: 王老师在空白许可证上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank work permit at the tank site.
shots.narration: 进入前：先办作业许可。
overlay: 进入前先办作业许可、人员受训

shots.section_title: 进入前先办作业许可、人员受训
shots.scene: 阿杰和工人在培训课上听讲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and workers in hard hats attend a training class in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 所有进入人员，都要受过进入培训。

shots.section_title: 作业前授权人员气体检测
shots.scene: 老李在人孔口用气体检测仪测气
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a gas detector at the manhole opening before work starts.
shots.narration: 开工前，由授权检测员测气。
overlay: 作业前授权人员气体检测

shots.section_title: 指派监护人并使用进出登记表
shots.scene: 保卫处值班员站在人孔旁，手拿空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: The security officer stands at the manhole holding a blank entry log sheet.
shots.narration: 指派监护人，用进出登记表。
overlay: 指派监护人并使用进出登记表

shots.section_title: 指派监护人并使用进出登记表
shots.scene: 监护人对着人孔里喊话，用对讲机联络
shots.prompt_en: The security officer talks into a radio and calls down into the manhole.
shots.narration: 和进入人员保持经常联络。

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、进出通道
shots.scene: 风机把新鲜空气吹进人孔
shots.prompt_en: A ventilation blower pushes fresh air through a duct into the manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 保证通风良好。
overlay: 通风、低压照明、进出通道

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、进出通道
shots.scene: 罐内一盏低压安全灯
shots.prompt_en: A low voltage safety lamp hangs inside the tank, with a small voltage icon. No people.
shots.narration: 照明充足，用24伏灯具减少电火花。

shots.section_title: 通风、低压照明、进出通道
shots.scene: 人孔口放着梯子，通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: A ladder placed clear at the manhole with an open path around it. No people.
shots.narration: 保证进出通道畅通。

shots.section_title: 应急救援预案与救援装备
shots.scene: 王老师给工人讲解空白救援预案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank rescue plan to workers next to the tank.
shots.narration: 所有人都要熟悉应急救援预案。
overlay: 应急救援预案与救援装备

shots.section_title: 应急救援预案与救援装备
shots.scene: 担架、全身安全带、吊装设备、三脚架图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stretcher, a full-body harness, a lifting hoist and a tripod over a manhole. No people.
shots.narration: 备好担架、安全带、吊装和三脚架。

shots.section_title: 应急救援预案与救援装备
shots.scene: 空气呼吸器和急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a self-contained breathing apparatus and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 还有空气呼吸器和急救箱。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员守在人孔旁，看着登记表
shots.prompt_en: The security officer watches the manhole and checks the blank log sheet.
shots.narration: 监护人：懂受限空间危害的人。

shots.scene: 监护人举手示意，拿起对讲机
shots.prompt_en: The security officer raises a hand and picks up a radio, ready to respond.
shots.narration: 知道出了问题该怎样应对，并做登记。

shots.scene: 管道、容器、储罐、筒仓、风管图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pipe, a vessel, a storage tank, a silo and an air duct. No people.
shots.narration: 举例：管道、容器、储罐、筒仓、风管。

shots.scene: 深坑旁一个深度标尺
shots.prompt_en: A deep excavation pit with a depth ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有深度超过1.2米的开挖。

shots.scene: 焊接、切割、打磨三个火花图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with sparks: welding, cutting and grinding. No people.
shots.narration: 动火作业：可能成为点火源的作业。

shots.scene: 黄色气团图标，旁边骷髅和腐蚀图标
shots.prompt_en: A yellowish gas cloud icon with a skull pictogram and a corrosion pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 硫化氢：有毒、有腐蚀性的气体。

shots.scene: 很小的气团也带着红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A very small gas cloud with a big red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 很低的浓度就能危及生命。

shots.scene: 臭鸡蛋图标和酸味图标
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon rotten egg with stink lines and a sour face icon. No people.
shots.narration: 又叫臭鸡蛋气、酸气。

shots.scene: 过滤式面罩和带软管的供气面罩
shots.prompt_en: Two respirator icons: a filter mask and a mask connected by a long hose to an air source. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器分两大类。

shots.scene: 空气穿过滤罐进入面罩
shots.prompt_en: Air flows through a filter cartridge into a mask, with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤式：净化周围空气再呼吸。

shots.scene: 压缩空气经软管送进面罩
shots.prompt_en: Compressed air travels from a separate source through a hose into a mask. No people.
shots.narration: 供气式：独立气源经软管供气。

shots.scene: 消防员背着气瓶的呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon firefighter wearing a breathing apparatus with an air cylinder on the back.
shots.narration: SCBA：自带气瓶的空气呼吸器。

shots.scene: 救援队员背着呼吸器站在人孔旁
shots.prompt_en: A rescue worker wearing a breathing apparatus stands ready beside a manhole.
shots.narration: 一般由消防员和受限空间救援队使用。

shots.scene: 潜水员背着气瓶在水下
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon diver with an air tank swims underwater. No other people.
shots.narration: SCUBA：自携式水下呼吸器。

shots.scene: 水面上下两个图标，水下的气瓶更大
shots.prompt_en: A split view above and below a water line: a breathing apparatus above and a larger diving tank below. No people.
shots.narration: 水下用SCUBA，水上用SCBA；它更重。

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 气瓶剖面，里面是普通空气分子
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of an air cylinder filled with ordinary air molecules. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶里装的是压缩的普通空气。
overlay: 估算呼吸器的供气时间

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 肺部图标旁一个计时器
shots.prompt_en: A lung icon next to a one-minute timer and a small air cube. No people.
shots.narration: 每分钟呼吸约需1.5立方英尺空气。

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 三十个小空气块合成一大块
shots.prompt_en: Thirty small air cubes merge into one big cube. No people.

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 压力表三个读数，对应三个时钟
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge with three marked readings, each linked to a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 压力表读数，就代表剩余空气量。

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 三个数字牌和三个时钟
shots.prompt_en: Three blank number cards paired with three clocks of increasing time. No people.

shots.section_title: 估算呼吸器的供气时间
shots.scene: 第三个数字牌和时钟亮起
shots.prompt_en: The third number card and the longest clock light up. No people.
shots.narration: 300巴，大约45分钟。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在人孔旁，身边浮现危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the manhole with floating hazard icons around it.
shots.narration: 受限空间：进出受限，危害多。

shots.scene: 许可证、检测仪、登记表、风机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a permit, a gas detector, a log sheet and a blower. No people.
shots.narration: 许可、培训、测气、监护、通风照明。

shots.scene: 救援三脚架和空气呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rescue tripod and a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉预案，备好救援装备。

shots.scene: 两种呼吸器和压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two respirator types and a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器分类，按压力估算时间。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在储罐前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the storage tanks.
shots.narration: 面试加油，下期再见！
